description: This PHP source file defines a class CalendarViewGetGRUsers that extends SugarView. It handles processing a request to retrieve user data based on user IDs provided in the request, and outputs JavaScript code to populate a JavaScript array with user information. It is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically within the Calendar module's views.

classes.name: CalendarViewGetGRUsers
classes.description: A class extending SugarView responsible for processing a request to get user data and outputting JavaScript to set a global users array.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Calls the display method to generate output.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves user IDs from the request, loads user beans, encodes their data into JSON, and outputs JavaScript code to assign the data to a global JavaScript variable.
